title: Reconstruction of coherent formal-system morphisms from limit-sheaf maps
statement: Let Y be Noetherian, J a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf, and G,H coherent J-adic formal modules [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]. For every O_Y-linear sheaf map β:lim G_n\to lim H_n, where both limits are in the category of module sheaves, there is a morphism α:G\to H of coherent formal modules whose induced limit map equals β. This is reconstruction for maps between limits of two coherent formal systems; there is no arbitrary pushforward system or proper morphism.

source.place: Lemma 087W and first half of Lemma 088B; checked at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/087W and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/088B

proof.text: Restrict G and H to an affine open U=Spec A, with I=J(U). The restriction object theorem gives coherent adic systems on U. Evaluation preserves limits, so a module-sheaf map β between their limits gives an A-linear map b between their section limits N and P.

Use coherentFormalModules_affine to identify each term with N/I^(n+1)N or P/I^(n+1)P via the specified surjective projections and ideal-power kernels. A-linearity of b preserves the ideal-power submodules, by applying b to finite sums of ideal multiples. Descend b to maps between these quotients. The affine tilde/sections equivalence translates them to component sheaf maps. Precompose the transition equations with the surjective projection of N: both sides then equal the same projection of b, so the transitions commute.

For a smaller affine open, restriction of the component maps satisfies the same equations because β is a sheaf map. Uniqueness follows from the surjective source projection there, so the restrictions agree with the construction on that smaller affine. Cover overlaps by smaller affine opens and glue each component using the sheaf axiom. The naturality and projection equations hold on the basis, thus globally. The universal property of the limit gives lim.map α.hom=β. This proves reconstruction for an arbitrary module-sheaf map, without a proper morphism or comparison κ.

lean.statement:
theorem coherentFormalModule_limit_full {Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Y]
    (J : Y.IdealSheafData) (G H : CoherentFormalModule Y J)
    (β : limit G.obj ⟶ limit H.obj) :
    ∃ α : G ⟶ H, lim.map α.hom = β
